label: Identify actual apparel accessories and their complete comparison requirements
definition: Identify every exact actual required accessory and current property/application reference, distinguish item/type/variant from colour or brand and retain missing provenance, safe readiness or unknown characteristics before evaluation. Reading/physical support is recorded separately from the learner's choices; no fibre, strength or compatibility is inferred from looks.
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1

assessment.method: Observe the authored task and changed case; record support, actual result, errors and feedback.
criteria: Identifies every actual required accessory and full current comparison/application contract
Distinguishes exact item/variant/properties from superficial resemblance
Preserves unknown provenance, individual safe support and qualified criteria

evidence_basis: Individually authored Atlas proposal. Source facets are mapped in the profession route; no external practitioner review, learner observation or occupational certification is claimed.
input_specification: The qualified apparel owner supplies varied actual benign appropriate buttons/fasteners, zips, ribbons and other required accessory samples, full current manufacturer/item/material/dimension/function/condition evidence and independent complete comparison/application criteria. All actual required types/variants and relevant wearing-apparel uses are inventoried; the examples are not a claim to every world accessory. Sharp, powered, tiny choking-risk or unsafe components need appropriate individual/qualified arrangements and are not assumed suitable for early learners.
output_specification: Identifies every actual required accessory and full current comparison/application contract; Distinguishes exact item/variant/properties from superficial resemblance; Preserves unknown provenance, individual safe support and qualified criteria
